language.title: Language
language.comingSoon: More languages are on the way.

auth.title: Sync account
auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account!
auth.syncNotConfigured: Sync is not configured for this build.

signOutBlocked.title: Unsynced changes
signOutBlocked.description: You have {{total}} change(s) that have not reached the cloud yet ({{pending}} pending operations, {{unsynced}} unsynced rows). Try syncing again or discard local changes before signing out.
signOutBlocked.inline: Sync your local changes before signing in with a different account.

forgotPasswordPage.title: Reset password
forgotPasswordPage.description: Enter the email for your sync account. We will send a link to choose a new password.
forgotPasswordPage.sent: If an account exists for {{email}}, you will receive a reset link shortly. Check your inbox and spam folder.

resetPasswordPage.title: New password
resetPasswordPage.invalidLink: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
resetPasswordPage.updatedDescription: Your password has been changed. You are signed in with your sync account.
resetPasswordPage.chooseDescription: Choose a new password for your sync account.
resetPasswordPage.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters.

screen.title: Upwards
screen.subtitle: Sign in to keep your days, journal and habits in one place, on every device.
screen.offline: You're offline. Signing in needs a connection the first time; after that Upwards works offline.

backup.action: Save a backup of this device first
backup.hint: A file with everything on this device, in case you want it later. Nothing is sent or removed.
backup.failed: Couldn't save the backup. Try again, or choose below if you don't need one.

sync.title: Cloud sync
sync.description: Your data syncs automatically. Open Sync issues to review conflicts or errors.

ai.title: AI insights
ai.description: Bring your own OpenAI-compatible API key. It's stored server-side and never sent back to any device — only used to generate periodic, aggregated insights.
ai.apiKeySavedPlaceholder: Key saved — enter a new one to replace it
ai.notSignedIn: Sign in to sync to set up AI insights.
ai.syncNotConfigured: Sync is not configured for this build.

backup.title: Backup
backup.description: Download a copy of your data, or bring one back. Importing merges with what is already here and never adds counts twice.

export.label: Export
export.hint: Each export syncs first. Daily clips download as one file per year.
export.noClips: No daily clips to export yet.
export.missingMedia_one: {{count}} file couldn't be downloaded and is not in the backup.
export.missingMedia_other: {{count}} files couldn't be downloaded and are not in the backup.
export.failed: Couldn't create the backup. Try again.

import.label: Import
import.hint: Accepts Upwards backup and clips files (.zip), and older .json backups.
import.keptNewer_one: {{count}} item kept as is — this account has a newer version.
import.keptNewer_other: {{count}} items kept as is — this account has newer versions.
import.conflicts_one: {{count}} journal entry has different text in the backup. Choose which to keep in Sync issues.
import.conflicts_other: {{count}} journal entries have different text in the backup. Choose which to keep in Sync issues.
import.clipsUnmatched_one: {{count}} clip has no matching journal day here. Import the data backup first, then the clips again.
import.clipsUnmatched_other: {{count}} clips have no matching journal day here. Import the data backup first, then the clips again.
import.failed: Couldn't import that file. It's safe to try again.

blocked.offline: Import needs a connection, so your data can sync before and after.
blocked.update_required: Update Upwards to import — this version can't sync.
blocked.pending_changes_one: {{count}} change on this device hasn't uploaded yet. Import works once it has — check Sync issues.
blocked.pending_changes_other: {{count}} changes on this device haven't uploaded yet. Import works once they have — check Sync issues.
blocked.sync_failed: Sync didn't finish, so import is paused. Check Sync issues and try again.

fileError.unrecognized: That file isn't an Upwards backup.
fileError.newer_version: That backup comes from a newer version of Upwards. Update the app, then import it.
fileError.sign_in_required: Sign in to restore daily clips.

page.title: Sync issues
page.subtitle: Review conflicts, pending changes, and sync errors

review.title: Needs your review
review.description: Changes from different devices that need your decision.
review.empty: Nothing needs your review right now.

pending.title: Waiting to sync
pending.description: Local changes saved on this device that have not reached the cloud yet.
pending.empty: All local changes have been sent to the cloud.

errors.title: Sync errors
errors.description: Problems that need a retry or fix—not everyday fetch noise from leaving the app mid-sync.

device.title: Devices
device.description: Installations signed in to your sync account.

info.title: Notes
info.description: Non-blocking sync notices that may need a quick look.

discardDialog.title: Discard local change?
discardDialog.message: This removes the pending change from this device only. It will not be uploaded, and you cannot undo this from another device.

conflict.bothChangedHint: Both sides changed some of the same fields. Combine will keep your value for those.
conflict.combinableHint: These changes touch different fields and can be combined cleanly.
conflict.combineWithPreferenceHint: Fields edited on both sides will keep your value.
conflict.resolveFailed: Could not apply that choice. Try again.

journal.summary: Two versions of this journal entry need a decision.
journal.backupSummary: This journal entry has different text in a backup you imported.
journal.consequence: Your choice updates this journal entry and syncs it to your other devices.

projection.summary: Two versions of this {{entity}} need a decision.
projection.consequence: Your choice updates this item and syncs it to your other devices.

dailyCounts.summary: Habit counts for {{date}} differ between this device and the cloud.
dailyCounts.consequence: Your choice updates today's counts on this device and syncs them.

taskOrder.title: Task order
taskOrder.description: Reorder scheduled tasks shown on the home page.
taskOrder.loadError: Couldn't load activities. Please try again.
taskOrder.empty: No scheduled activities available to reorder.

optIns.title: Privacy and extras
optIns.description: Both are off until you turn them on, and they follow your account to your other devices.

autoLocation.label: Add my location to today automatically
autoLocation.hint: When on, Upwards asks your device where you are and adds the nearest city to today's journal. When off, it never asks. You can still add places by searching.
autoLocation.denied: Location access is blocked for this app. Allow it in your browser or device settings, then try again.
autoLocation.unsupported: This device or browser can't share its location.

dailyClip.label: Daily clip
dailyClip.hint: Record one short clip a day. When off, the clip option, video filter and video previews are hidden. Your recorded clips are kept.

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.description: Holidays appear as banners in your journal feed and in search. Pick the calendars you follow; it's separate from your language.

US.label: United States
US.hint: New Year's Day, Thanksgiving, Independence Day, Halloween and more.

BR.label: Brazil
BR.hint: Carnaval, Tiradentes, Independência do Brasil, Finados and more.

GLOBAL.label: Around the world
GLOBAL.hint: Lunar New Year, Holi, Ramadan, Eid, Diwali, Hanukkah, Easter and Day of the Dead.

hemisphere.label: Seasons
hemisphere.hint: Month banners show winter or summer scenes to match where you live.

birthday.label: Your birthday
birthday.hint: Shows as a banner in your journal on your birthday each year, with your age. Only you can see it, and it's never shared or sent to AI.
